entities.summary: Mya Tun Oo is a Burmese army general and politician who currently serves as the Union Minister for Transport and Communications of Myanmar since August 2023, prior to which he held the position of Union Minister of Defence and member of the State Administration Council (SAC) since February 2021, and is a member-elect of the Pyithu Hluttaw. He was also a deputy prime minister from February 2023 to July 2025.
